title: Stratum program-synthesis solver request (v1)
description: Input to the program-synthesis solver: weekly volume targets plus the lifter/program-generation context. Produced by the Kotlin request producer (ProgramSynthesisWire.encodeRequest), consumed by the Python solver. See solver-contract/VERSIONING.md for modelVersion semantics. This schema is the producer contract: CI validates producer output against it strictly. Decoders implement the separate lenient mode in VERSIONING.md §2 and MUST NOT validate inbound payloads against this raw schema.

modelVersion.description: Contract major version. Producers MUST emit it. Servers MUST treat a missing value as "v1" (pre-versioned Kotlin wire payloads) and MUST reject unknown majors. Minor suffix (v1.1) is backward compatible; dispatch is on the major.

weeklyTargets.description: Weekly volume targets keyed by MuscleGroup name. From planWeeklyVolume: min = MEV floor, aim = weekly aim, max = weekly ceiling, in hard-set credits.

nullableMovementPattern.title: NullableMovementPattern
nullableMovementPattern.description: Movement pattern that may be null when unclassified or without override.

fatigueProfile.title: FatigueProfile
fatigueProfile.description: Loading/recovery cost band. High = spine-loaded free-weight compounds, Medium = other multi-joint compounds, Low = lighter accessories.

nullableWeight.title: NullableWeight
nullableWeight.description: Weight that may be null (open-ended tier bound, unknown 1RM).

min.description: MEV floor in hard-set credits. 0 when the muscle has no minimum.

trainingAge.description: Self-reported training age, TrainingAge enum name (Beginner, EarlyIntermediate, Intermediate, LateIntermediate, Advanced) or "" when unknown. Free-form string on the wire; unknown values MUST be tolerated.

lastTrained.description: LastTrainedBucket enum name (WithinLastThreeMonths, MoreThanThreeMonthsAgo, Never), or null when unknown. Free-form string on the wire; unknown values MUST be tolerated.

sessionLengthMinutes.description: Target session length in minutes, or null when unset (no session time cap).

trainingDaysPerWeek.description: Training session count for this generation (N). MUST be >= 1.

specialization.description: Per-muscle specialization level. Muscles absent from this map default to Maintenance.

liftsById.description: Lift catalog entries keyed by lift id.

muscleVolumeSnapshotsByMuscle.description: Per-muscle MV/PV/RC snapshots keyed by MuscleGroup name.

volumeCorrelationsByMuscle.description: Per-muscle dose/response correlations keyed by MuscleGroup name.

enabledLiftIds.description: Lift ids the user enabled for this program.

movementPatternByLiftId.description: Resolved movement pattern per lift id; null when the lift has no pattern override.

liftEffectivenessByLiftId.description: Per-lift effectiveness rank/evidence keyed by lift id.

restSlotIndices.description: Optional cycle-space rest pattern: indices in [0, cycleLength). Omitted when unset (server applies defaults).

cycleLength.description: Optional full cycle length (train + rest slots). Omitted when unset (server applies defaults).

movementPattern.description: Primary movement pattern, or null when unclassified.

mainstream.description: Whether the lift is mainstream, or null when unknown.

progressTrend.description: Free-form progress trend label (e.g. "up"), or null when unknown.

proven.description: Whether the lift is in the proven tier (matched from logged history), or null when unknown.

sessionCount.description: Number of logged sessions for this lift, or null/0 when no insights.

effectivenessRank.description: Within-pattern effectiveness rank (1 = best), or null when undefined.

effectivenessEvidence.description: Effectiveness evidence tier label, or null when unknown.

fatigueDecaySlope.description: Within-session fatigue decay slope, or null when unknown.

fatigueDecayIntercept.description: Within-session fatigue decay intercept, or null when unknown.

muscleLengthBias.description: MuscleLengthBias enum name (Lengthened, Shortened, MidRange), or null when unknown.

equipment.description: Free-form equipment label (e.g. "barbell"), or null when unknown.

fatigueProfile.description: Loading/recovery cost band. Decoders default a missing value to Low; producers MUST emit it.

incrementTiers.description: Weight-banded increment steps. Empty when the lift has no tier data. Decoders default a missing array to empty; producers MUST emit it.

estimatedOneRm.description: Estimated one-rep max from training insights, or null when no proven history exists.

upperBound.description: Upper bound of the tier, or null for the open-ended top tier.

muscle.description: MuscleGroup name. Free-form string on the wire (mirrors the map key).

posture.description: Free-form volume posture label (e.g. "Productive"), or null when unknown.

muscle.description: MuscleGroup name. Free-form string on the wire (mirrors the map key).
